business.description: Kobo Biotech Limited operates in the pharmaceuticals segment. The company could not resume operational activities at its Solapur plant due to regulatory and financial issues.

outlook.statement: Resolution Plan submitted by Beaufond Industries Limited has been approved by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench, vide order dated 11th May, 2026. Pending implementation of the approved Resolution Plan, the affairs of the Corporate Debtor continue to be managed by the Resolution Professional.
The Resolution Plan submitted by Beaufond Industries Limited was approved by the NCLT, Hyderabad Bench vide order dated 11th May, 2026.
